# G-Maiden

G-Maiden is a local-first Dota 2 companion for match-state awareness, the command deck, voice
alerts, and optional account features. Local setup and gameplay runtime do not require sign-in.

## Current product and engineering contracts

- [MVP decisions](docs/product/mvp-decisions.md) — scope, optional account use, privacy, quality, and acceptance.
- [Product roadmap](docs/product/roadmap.md) — current MVP milestones and work order.
- [Software requirements](docs/product/software-requirements-specification.md) — functional and non-functional requirements.
- [Architecture](docs/architecture/technical-design-document.md) — system boundaries and runtime flows.
- [Feature ledger](docs/FEATURE-LEDGER.md) — current feature-to-source registry.
- [Documentation index](docs/DOC-INDEX.md) — canonical documentation map.

## Source map

- Desktop UI: `src/src/App.tsx`, `src/src/CommandDeck.tsx`, `src/src/AccountPage.tsx`.
- Rust runtime: `src-tauri/src/lib.rs`, `src-tauri/src/gsi.rs`, `src-tauri/src/governor.rs`.
- GID and account identity: `src/src/gid.ts`, `src/src/auth.ts`, `supabase/functions/_shared/identity.ts`.
- Landing site and public demo: `landing/src/App.tsx`, `landing/src/PublicDemo.tsx`.
- Release channels: `docs/releases/release-channel-architecture.md` and `release/channels/`.
- Privacy and security: `docs/audits/SEC-001-auth-identity-hardening.md`, `docs/product/mvp-decisions.md`.

## Validation

Use the repository `AGENTS.md` and `CLAUDE.md` for required checks, branch rules, privacy constraints,
and release approvals. A source build or CI result does not by itself certify native user acceptance
or authorize a release.
